english.title: Provide false information re entry in register / obtaining ID card - Identity Cards Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) provided false information to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),

(A)_[for the purpose of securing the making or modification of an entry in the National Identity Register]_
(B)_[in confirming the contents of an entry in the National Identity Register]_
(C)_[for the purpose of obtaining for yourself the issue or modification of an ID card]_
(D)_[for the purpose of obtaining for another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), the issue or modification of an ID card]_

and at that time you knew or believed the information to be false or were reckless as to whether or not the information was false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28 of the Identity Cards Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
provided false information to a person
for the purpose of securing the making/modification of an entry in the National Identity Register OR

knowing/believing the information to be false/being reckless as to whether or not it was false

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For the current legislation, please see the Identity Documents Act 2010.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Twelve months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty is six months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
